__doc: PHOTOGRAPHS FOR HOMEPAGE CAMPUS CARDS, ADDED AFTER EXTRACTION.
The homepage campus gallery is extracted from Campus.astro AT GIT HEAD - the
const was migrated into the CMS and no longer exists in the working copy, so
the extractor reads the last commit to recover it. That means it can only ever
reproduce the five keys the site already had, and a photograph the school sends
later has nowhere to enter. A hand-edit to home.json is erased by the next
WARNING: A CARD WITH NO PHOTOGRAPHS IS NOT BROKEN. Two cards deliberately had
none - the panel renders their `brief` instead, which is the standing request
for the picture. Only add a key here when the photograph actually exists.
'why' is required by the merge, for the same reason it is on the academics
photo overrides: a picture placed on a card is a claim about the place it
shows, and the reason it belongs there should survive the person who added it.

archery.why: The card was Shooting Range with an open photo request. The school confirmed the range is for archery; the name, the copy and these photographs were corrected together.
